reporting-org.narrative: European Commission - Directorate-General for International Partnerships

title.narrative: Increasing awareness and accession to the Water Convention

description.narrative: The contract will promote accession and implementation of the Water Convention by supporting transboundary water cooperation, both surface and groundwater, at the national, basin and regional level across continents. The contract will provide capacity building on legal issues, technical support for accession and implementation, and assist countries by facilitating knowledge sharing and peer learning.
